definitions.gloss: autumn equinox period; autumn higan; autumn week of Buddhist memorial services
definitions.explanation: A seven-day period centered on the autumn equinox (around September 22-23), during which Japanese families visit ancestral graves and make offerings. The autumn counterpart of {春彼岸|はるひがん}.

examples.japanese: {秋彼岸|あきひがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦お{墓|はか}→お墓：21734_ohaka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I clean the graves during the autumn equinox period.

examples.japanese: {秋彼岸|あきひがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おはぎ→おはぎ：29365_ohagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{供|そな}え→お供え：25860_osonae⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧だ。
examples.english: It's traditional to offer ohagi during the autumn equinox period.

examples.japanese: {秋彼岸|あきひがん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{朝晩|あさばん}→朝晩：28955_asaban⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぐっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{涼|すず}しく→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: After the autumn equinox period passes, mornings and evenings become noticeably cooler, and you can feel autumn deepening.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ ('autumn') and ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧ ('equinox period'). The autumn counterpart of ⟦{春彼岸|はるひがん}→春彼岸：24285_haruhigan⟧, with the same structure of grave visits and offerings but associated with different seasonal imagery.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Like spring higan, spans seven days: three before, the equinox day, and three after
- The traditional offering is {御萩|おはぎ} (ohagi), a rice ball coated in red bean paste, named after the autumn bush clover ({萩|はぎ})
- {彼岸花|ひがんばな} (red spider lily) blooms around this time and is closely associated with the period
- The proverb ⟦{暑|あつ}さ→暑さ：12973_atsusa⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ ('heat and cold last until higan') marks this as a seasonal turning point

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秋彼岸|あきひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{墓参|はかまい}り→お墓参り：15303_ohakamairi⟧: autumn equinox grave visit
- {秋彼岸|あきひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入|い}り: start of the autumn higan period
- {秋彼岸|あきひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{中日|ちゅうにち}: the middle day (equinox itself)
- {秋彼岸|あきひがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧: end of the autumn higan period

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{春彼岸|はるひがん}→春彼岸：24285_haruhigan⟧: spring equinox period — the same observance around the spring equinox in March
- ⟦{彼岸|ひがん}→彼岸：12612_higan⟧: equinox period (general) — can refer to either spring or autumn higan
- ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧: Obon; Bon festival — another major ancestor memorial period in mid-August
